exposure: Mode of delivery (cesarean section vs vaginal delivery)
outcome: Practices related to intrauterine tamponade (mode of insertion, ultrasound control, use of vaginal gauze or antibiotic prophylaxis)
Residents' perception of their training in intrauterine tamponade
finding: Intrauterine tamponade is widely used in France regardless of the mode of delivery, however, there is a lack of standardized training for residents in this technique.
mod_finding: Intrauterine tamponade is used in both cesarean and vaginal deliveries.
